lines.text: The art class has moved. Could you help me with the signs for tonight?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes. The sign at the front door is ready, but I still need the room number.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: We are in room sixteen now. It is the first room on the left.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Do you mean the room by the stairs? I can put a sign there, too.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, that is the room. Could you also tell the group about the change?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The group message is ready. When do you need me to send it?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Please send it by three. People may leave home early to get here.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Okay. I will send the message now and put up the second sign after lunch.
lines.speaker: Eli
